description: Twelve fixed counterfactual twin pairs; expand each of two private values into one case (24 cases total). No expected answer field is rendered into model input.

rendering.instruction: Read the record and answer the question. Select exactly one option. Reply with only A or B.
rendering.shared_context: Both models receive the factual record with the same selected value.
rendering.private_fact_probe: Receiver sees UNKNOWN in place of {value}; donor sees the selected factual value. This deliberately departs from the released shared-context setup.
rendering.mismatch: Receiver input remains exactly fixed. Donor cache comes from the opposite member of the same pair, with the same question and choices. Assert all cache tensor shapes equal.

pairs.question: Where is the parcel stored?
What color is the new door?
Which object does the visitor find?
Which room should the caller visit?
Where is the token after the final move?
Which number is displayed now?
Does the other tray hold fewer or more coins than the first tray?
How many beads are now in the box?
Which color does the lamp show?
Should the ticket be accepted?
Which food does the shelter give the new arrival?
Is the path blocked by the gate?
